decomposition.method: source RGB mask + DA3 z-depth support in at least 2 source views
decomposition.source: previous trained NuRec RGB scene; no retraining; retained Gaussian parameters unchanged
decomposition.limitations: Estimated depth and detector masks may miss objects or remove some background. This is an experimental static/foreground decomposition.

models.label: AetherV1 · diffusion right
models.depth_encoding: uint16 little-endian, camera Z = value/65535*80; 0 = display-filtered
models.confidence_filter: no model confidence head; finite/range only

alignment.fit: First-camera orientation + one positive global scale; no per-frame correction

run.input: first RGB + camera raymap estimated from all 17 RGB frames in the separate reconstruction pass
run.empty_prompt: real T5 embedding; encoder released after upstream initialization
run.camera_postprocess: upstream raymap_to_poses, origin scale .1, no temporal smoothing
run.raymap: direction and signed-log origin; not Plucker moment

latent.capture: Actual final jointly denoised state before upstream modality decoding
